clue.text: No rare bird, best seen around at Christmas

definitions.text: No rare bird, best seen around at Christmas

indicators.note: around signals the letters of the opening words being moved about into a new order

parts.note: the fourteen letters of these four words are the anagram pool

explanation.surface: A common bird is at its finest when spotted during the festive season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' rearranges NO RARE BIRD BEST; the whole clue also describes the bird, a familiar sight on Christmas cards, so it doubles as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The robin is a common British garden bird and a traditional emblem on Christmas cards, so it is seen everywhere at that season.

clue.text: Formal protest about a gift

parts.note: re is a short Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning
a presentation is a gift formally handed over

explanation.surface: Someone lodges an official complaint concerning a present they received.
explanation.definitionFit: Making representations means formally stating objections or a case to an authority, a synonym for a formal protest.

clue.text: How prices are displayed by pub laws

parts.note: a bar is a pub or the counter in one
a code is a body of laws, as in the highway code

explanation.surface: Licensing regulations govern how drinks prices are shown in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Shop goods carry a printed pattern of stripes that the till scans to read the price, a modern way of displaying it.

clue.text: Hour being struck for close acquaintance

indicators.note: struck suggests knocked about, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A clock chimes the hour while someone meets a familiar friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struck' looks like a clock striking the hour, but it is the anagram signal for HOUR BEING.
explanation.definitionFit: The person living next door is typically someone you know at close quarters, a close acquaintance.

clue.text: Registered requirements for presents, getting one finally in consequence

indicators.note: in places the earlier pieces inside the word for consequence

parts.note: an end is an outcome or consequence, as in to that end
a list is what a child writes for Santa, the presents they require

indicators.note: finally picks out the closing letter of the word one

explanation.surface: Someone noted down their Christmas wish list, with one item finally added as a result.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlisted means enrolled or entered on a roll, which is to have registered.

clue.text: Shop's agents or customers at the January Sales?

definitions.meaning: a store's ... are the staff who purchase stock on its behalf
people purchasing bargains in the post-Christmas sales are shoppers making purchases

explanation.surface: Who are the people working for a store, or the crowds at the post-Christmas sales?
explanation.walkthrough: The January Sales are the big British post-Christmas discount period.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both professional purchasers employed by a shop and ordinary people paying for goods.

clue.text: Emile provides something fragrant — could be myrrh

indicators.note: provides suggests the name is made into something new, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: a French first name supplying five letters

explanation.surface: A man named Emile gives a scented present, perhaps one of the Magi's gifts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be myrrh' is a hint by example: like myrrh, the answer is an aromatic gum resin.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is a fragrant resin from tropical trees, used in perfumes and incense much as myrrh is.

clue.text: Eke out the bird

definitions.meaning: to make supplies last longer is to extend them
bird is slang for a prison sentence, from rhyming slang bird-lime for time

explanation.surface: Make the Christmas turkey go further.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests making the turkey last; 'bird' is British slang for a spell in prison, as is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to make something last longer and a term served in jail.

clue.text: It opens up as Christmas approaches

definitions.text: It opens up as Christmas approaches

parts.words: It opens up as Christmas approaches
parts.note: describes a card with little doors, one opened each day of December leading to the festival

explanation.surface: Something unfolds in the run-up to the festive season.
explanation.definitionFit: This seasonal card has windows opened one per day through December before Christmas Day.

clue.text: One and all included in the celebration, but not completely

indicators.note: included in puts the first pieces inside the word for the celebration

parts.note: a party is a celebration
I is the Roman numeral for one
taken as written

explanation.surface: Everyone came to the festivities, though not quite everything was finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Partially means in part only, so not completely.

clue.text: Hesitantly stated colour of Santa's hat and was wrong

parts.note: er is the sound a hesitant speaker makes
Father Christmas wears a red hat

explanation.surface: Someone stumbled over naming the shade of Father Christmas's cap and got it wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Erred is the past tense of err, to make a mistake, so it means was wrong.

clue.text: He grasps a policeman on the way back — it will mean time

indicators.note: on the way back says the whole assembly is read in the opposite direction
grasps means the first word holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: taken as written
cop is slang for a policeman

explanation.surface: A man seizes an officer as he returns, and that will mean a spell inside.
explanation.walkthrough: The arrest picture suggests 'time' means a prison term; it means an era. 'on the way back' reverses the combined HCOPE.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is a period or era of history, a span of time.

clue.text: It ensures you won't be spotted having Christmas dinner

definitions.text: It ensures you won't be spotted having Christmas dinner

parts.words: It ensures you won't be spotted having Christmas dinner
parts.note: spotted means stained with gravy, not seen; the item is a cloth tucked in at the table

explanation.surface: Something lets you eat the festive meal unseen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spotted' reads as 'seen' but means marked with food stains.
explanation.definitionFit: A serviette is a table napkin that protects clothes from food stains during a meal.

clue.text: Watches Rose dancing — horrors!

parts.note: to eye something is to watch it

indicators.note: dancing sets the letters of the name moving into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone observes a woman named Rose dancing and is appalled.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesores are ugly sights, things so unpleasant to look at they are horrors.

clue.text: In this way, there's a sort of thaw — but who cares?

parts.note: so means thus or in this way

indicators.note: a sort of implies a variant of the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The weather is warming up a bit, but nobody is bothered.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dismissive retorts expressing indifference to what has just been said.

clue.text: This is an essential part of a player's score

definitions.text: This is an essential part of a player's score

parts.words: This is an essential part of a player's score
parts.note: score means written music, not points; the term marks an instrumental line that must not be omitted

explanation.surface: A sportsman's tally depends on one key element.
explanation.walkthrough: 'player' and 'score' suggest a game; they mean a musician and sheet music.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, an obbligato is an accompanying instrumental part marked as indispensable to the piece.

clue.text: Showed touching affection under the mistletoe?

definitions.text: Showed touching affection under the mistletoe?

parts.words: Showed touching affection under the mistletoe?
parts.note: touching here is literal, physical stroking, rather than moving or poignant

explanation.surface: A couple displayed sweet tenderness beneath the Christmas greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: To caress is to stroke or touch someone gently as a sign of love.

clue.text: A number tucked into a bird in the inn

indicators.note: tucked into places the first pieces inside the word for a bird

parts.note: a tern is a seabird
V is the Roman numeral five, a number

explanation.surface: A figure is stuffed inside a fowl at the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A tavern is a public house serving drink, essentially an inn.

clue.text: House includes an ice cream flavour for dessert

indicators.note: includes means the house word holds the next piece within it

parts.note: a villa is a large house

explanation.surface: A home offers a pudding of ice cream in a particular flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanilla, from an orchid pod, is the most common flavour of ice cream served as a dessert.

clue.text: Find crab near Australian city

indicators.note: find suggests the letters are to be worked out from a muddled form

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone goes looking for a crustacean close to a capital down under.
explanation.definitionFit: Canberra is the purpose-built federal capital city of Australia.

clue.text: Drawer for the Christmas presents?

parts.note: drawer means one who draws or pulls, not a sliding box: a reindeer hauling Santa's sleigh of gifts

explanation.surface: A chest of drawers where the festive gifts are hidden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drawer' looks like furniture but means a puller.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudolph is the famous red-nosed reindeer who pulls Father Christmas's sleigh laden with gifts.

clue.text: Panto dame's outsize accoutrement makes her an important person

parts.note: big means large or outsize
a wig is an item worn, part of the dame's costume

explanation.surface: The pantomime dame's oversized headpiece makes her look grand.
explanation.walkthrough: A pantomime dame is a man in drag playing a comic old woman in a British Christmas show, famous for huge wigs.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigwig is informal for a person of importance or high rank.

clue.text: Christmas fare from the Argentine

indicators.note: from suggests the answer is made out of the following letters, rearranged

parts.note: the country name Argentine supplies the nine letters

explanation.surface: Seasonal food imported from Argentina.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' reads as origin; it signals that ARGENTINE is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangerines are small citrus fruit traditionally put in Christmas stockings or eaten at the festive table.

clue.text: Accept an invitation and stop being an outsider

definitions.meaning: to come in when asked, as in come in and do
to come inside rather than stay out

explanation.surface: Respond to the summons and join the circle.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to come in when invited and to join, no longer standing outside.

clue.text: I dine out with a music group

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are knocked out of their order

parts.note: the four letters of these words, anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Someone eats away from home in the company of a band.
explanation.definitionFit: An indie is an independent record label or a band in that alternative style.

clue.text: It may be snowy when this bird is born

definitions.text: It may be snowy when this bird is born

parts.words: It may be snowy when this bird is born
parts.note: snowy refers to a species of white Arctic owl, not the weather at the hatching

explanation.surface: Wintry weather greets a chick's hatching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snowy' looks like weather; it names a species, the snowy owl, whose young bird this is.
explanation.definitionFit: An owlet is a young owl, and the snowy owl is one species of it.

clue.text: Went around singing carols, yet complained about a wise man's transport

indicators.note: about means the complaining word goes around the next piece

parts.note: wailed means moaned or complained loudly
an ass or donkey might carry a traveller to the Nativity; jokingly given to a wise man

explanation.surface: Carol singers made the rounds while grumbling about the Magi's mount.
explanation.definitionFit: To wassail is to go from house to house singing carols and drinking toasts at Christmas.

clue.text: Charming marriage after this nursery guardian's spell in panto

definitions.text: Charming marriage after this nursery guardian's spell in panto

parts.words: Charming marriage after this nursery guardian's spell in panto
parts.note: Charming is Prince Charming, who weds Cinderella after her magical protector's spell sends her to the ball

explanation.surface: In a Christmas pantomime a delightful wedding follows a nanny's period on duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charming' is the prince in Cinderella, not an adjective; 'spell' is magic, not a period. Pantomime is a British Christmas stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: In Cinderella, her magical protector conjures the coach and gown that lead to her marriage.
